rejection_reasons: The supplied records do not meet the minimum corroboration requirement. There is only one publisher domain (punchng.com) covering the Kwara APC governorship denial story, and only one publisher domain (thereporter.com.ng) covering the Abia APC consultation story. At least two different publisher domains must materially support the same central event to proceed with publication.

Two independent media outlets (Western Post and Premium Times Nigeria) corroborate Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu's announcement setting a target to raise Lagos State's electricity supply to 3,000MW by March 2027.

The supplied records do not contain corroboration across at least two independent publisher domains for any single event. The Makinde/Adelabu story appears only on punchng.com, while the Atiku petrol proposal story appears exclusively on thereporter.com.ng.
